api.title: AI service (OpenAI-compatible)
api.hint: Put your AI service account here; the chat and every other AI feature runs on it.
api.priceCurrencyHint: This model is billed in a different currency on each platform. Pick the one your API key belongs to, so the spending page matches your bill.

network.title: Internet
network.hint: Turn this off and everything that needs the internet, API calls included, stops.

mainland.title: Mainland China network
mainland.hint: Fact-checking uses only sources reachable from mainland China (Bing); turned off, it prefers Wikipedia.

language.title: Language
language.thinNote: The AI writes {{language}} less well than it writes {{fallback}}. You can change the answer language on its own and leave the interface as it is.

quietIssues.title: Background work
quietIssues.allGood: Everything in the background is fine.
quietIssues.summary_one: {{count}} small background job did not finish recently. Your learning is unaffected — open to see which one
quietIssues.summary_other: {{count}} small background jobs did not finish recently. Your learning is unaffected — open to see which ones

billing.intro: Every step that costs money has its own switch here, and its spending is tracked separately. This page shows what was actually spent.

diglot.name: 🧵 Language learning · smart swaps
diglot.hint: The stronger version of language learning: the AI picks the translation that fits the sentence and occasionally swaps in a natural phrase. One small call per message.

chat.name: 💬 Chat
chat.hint: Your everyday conversation with the AI. This is the core feature and stays on; what it costs is listed here too.

knowledgeTree.name: 🌳 Knowledge map
knowledgeTree.hint: After each exchange, the AI files what you talked about into your map. One call per round.

factcheck.name: 🔍 Fact-checking
factcheck.hint: Tap "Check this" under a reply and the AI looks up the claims in public sources.

knowledgeEdges.name: 🕸️ Knowledge links
knowledgeEdges.hint: When something new is filed, the AI looks at how it connects to what you already know. A small charge each time.

interest.name: 💡 Personal recommendations
interest.hint: The AI notices what interests you and where you get stuck, and uses that to adjust what it suggests; it is also what recognises which topic you mean when you say "I already know this".

goalPlanning.name: 🎯 Goal planning
goalPlanning.hint: When you set a goal, the AI turns it into a list of things to learn. One call per goal.

compareProfileBuild.name: 🌲 Comparison research (experimental)
compareProfileBuild.hint: For comparisons outside the built-in occupation list, the AI searches public sources, builds the list and checks each source. Takes a few minutes.

compareAlignment.name: 🌉 Comparison matching
compareAlignment.hint: During a comparison, the AI decides whether your wording and the source's wording mean the same thing. Each pair is judged once.

teachQuality.name: 🎓 Teach-back feedback
teachQuality.hint: After you explain something to a companion, the AI reads how it went; the parts you explained clearly are recorded.

mapTopicNaming.name: 🗺️ Map naming (experimental)
mapTopicNaming.hint: On the map, the AI names each area that formed on its own. Each area is named once.

feedbackLab.name: 🪞 Recently
feedbackLab.hint: The review panel beside the map: computed entirely from local data, costs nothing.

companionChat.name: 🎭 Companion chat
companionChat.hint: Three AI study companions: open a chat, and now and then one asks you to explain something or to review together.

companionMemory.name: 🧠 Companion memory
companionMemory.hint: Companions remember what you talked about, and tidy those memories now and then so they stay coherent.

companionScript.name: 📜 Companion prep
companionScript.hint: Before you start explaining, the companion who will listen reads up on the topic so it can follow you. A small charge per round while you explain.

focusExplain.name: 🔎 Focus explanations
focusExplain.hint: In focus mode, picking a word or asking a question gets you an explanation. Each word is explained once.

termMarking.name: 🖊️ Word marking
termMarking.hint: The AI marks the words in a reply you may not know yet; tap one to see what it means. Each reply is marked once.

research.panelIntro: Every number here was computed by this computer. The tasks are reviewed and their sources can be checked; the data does not leave this device on its own, and none of this costs anything.
research.offNotice: Research tasks are off: no new task will run. Results you already have are kept, and you can read or delete them one by one.
research.emptyHint: While the app is idle it computes signed research tasks locally; results appear here when they are done.
research.deleteConfirmPrompt: Deleting this result cannot be undone. Delete it?
research.settingsRowHint: Runs reviewed research tasks locally and shows the results; the data does not leave this device on its own and it costs nothing
research.closeConfirmWhatItDoes: The research platform runs reviewed, project-signed tasks locally, computes the statistics and shows them to you.
research.closeConfirmDataStaysLocal: All of it is computed here; the data does not leave this device on its own.
research.closeConfirmResearchValue: Local aggregate statistics like these let researchers study how people learn without collecting anyone's personal data.
research.closeConfirmWhatChanges: Once off, no task will run and you will not be asked about this again. Results you already have are untouched and stay in the panel.
